verdict.rationale: Metorial explicitly supports per-end-user OAuth connections ('each user connects their own apps and keeps the permissions they should have'), portals for end-user account connection, tool filters/scoping per session, and an Agents/Workforce view to audit which agent used which connection. This directly matches the platform-engineer story of isolating credentials per end user. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of strict per-user token isolation at runtime (community feedback notes docs are unclear on auth mechanics), and no explicit confirmation of scoped-token issuance per agent instance beyond OAuth connection model.
